Title: Create a new item with a status and verify the status is displayed
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Create New Item' screen
Steps:
1. Enter 'Summer Dress' in the 'Item Name' field. 2. Select 'ACTIVE' from the 'Status' dropdown. 3. Add at least one measuring parameter (e.g., 'Waist' with unit 'cm'). 4. Click the 'Save' button. 5. Navigate to the item details page for the newly created item.

Test Data: Item Name: Summer Dress, Status: ACTIVE, Measuring Parameter: Waist (cm)
Expected Result: The item details page displays the item with name 'Summer Dress', status 'ACTIVE', and the measuring parameter 'Waist (cm)' listed under its parameters.

Title: Update an existing item's status and verify the change is reflected
Preconditions: User is logged in, and there is at least one existing item with status 'ACTIVE' in the system
Steps:
1. Navigate to the list of items. 2. Select an item with status 'ACTIVE' (e.g., 'Formal Shirt'). 3. Click the 'Edit' button. 4. Change the status from 'ACTIVE' to 'INACTIVE'. 5. Click the 'Save' button. 6. Reopen the item details page for the updated item.

Test Data: Item: Formal Shirt, New Status: INACTIVE
Expected Result: The item details page displays the item with name 'Formal Shirt', updated status 'INACTIVE', and all previously associated measuring parameters unchanged.

Title: Retrieve all items and verify their statuses are displayed
Preconditions: User is logged in, and there are at least two items in the system with different statuses (e.g., one 'ACTIVE' and one 'ARCHIVED')
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Items' list page. 2. Observe the list of items displayed.

Test Data: Items: [Item 1: T-Shirt (ACTIVE), Item 2: Winter Coat (ARCHIVED)]
Expected Result: The items list displays each item with its name and status (e.g., 'T-Shirt - ACTIVE', 'Winter Coat - ARCHIVED'), along with their measuring parameters.

Expected Result: The system displays an error message indicating that the 'status' field is required and prevents the item from being saved.
